question: Which divine figures preside on the Bhāgīrathī and at Kāmpilla?
premises: Bhāgīrathyāṃ names the first sacred site.
Padmagarbhaḥ is the presiding figure there.
Kāmpille names the second sacred site.
Kanakapriyaḥ is the presiding figure there.
inference: Padmagarbha presides on the Bhāgīrathī and Kanakapriya presides at Kāmpilla.
plain_english: On the Bhāgīrathī is Padmagarbha, and at Kāmpilla is Kanakapriya.
